features: exposure_load read-only tool; default live source

research_basis.title: Asken et al., drill-specific collegiate practice exposure
research_basis.checked: Primary research abstract: drill/position rates and participation minutes matter. No universal highest-contact drill established.

research_basis.title: Urban et al., high-school exposure
research_basis.checked: 40 players, 16,502 impacts; 9.4/practice and 15.5/game are study averages, not fixture validation or device calibration.

research_basis.title: Riddell sample reports
research_basis.checked: Practice plans, national norms by playing level/position, and personal history. Proprietary load metric not reproduced.

corrections_to_claude_proposal: No claim that reducing ODR to 800 Hz would validate equivalence with HIT; firmware unchanged during this work.
No change from current 50 ms shock duration without physical waveform evidence.
Riddell uses proprietary metrics and national norms as well as personal history; our 2.5x rate and 2x median rules are explicit demo heuristics.
Synthetic history examples are authored, not representative concussion prevalence or clinical predictions.
No comparison of live inner-shell g readings with published head-acceleration thresholds.

live_preservation.reconnect_note: A heartbeat gap and HTTP failures were observed before/during server work; delivery recovered automatically after restart. Latest fresh heartbeat confirmed, same board boot, zero queue/drops. No uninterrupted-link claim is made.
